sourceSentences: [0] Trade around his passive. Ziggs' passive empowers his auto attack. Don't try to trade with him when this is up and instead wait for him to waste it on a minion while farming.
[0] Punish his W cool down. Ziggs' only form of escape is his W. If he uses this aggressively, make sure you punish him for it, especially if his flash is already on cool down.
[0] Ziggs' passive and W both help him shred down those towers. Be sure to punish him when he overextends to take them down.
[0] Avoid the epicenter of his ultimate. In the early mid game, needs to hit you in the center for it to really deal damage.
[0] Be careful not to chase him into his minefield. Ziggs works well on the back foot as he can litter the floor with abilities as you look to chase him.
[1] his design makes him weak against any Champion that outranges him and his turrets but incredibly obnoxious for any melee Champion as they are forced to play inside of his turrets
